utterances.speaker: EMIN KABASHI
utterances.text: The objective of the KLA from the beginning and until the war was over was the liberation of Kosova.

utterances.speaker: MR. DJURDJIC
utterances.text: Thank you. How many of your students were members of the KLA?

utterances.speaker: EMIN KABASHI
utterances.text: I don't know the number, but far too many, and many of them were killed.

utterances.speaker: MR. DJURDJIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Would you agree with me that in the Milutinovic trial you stated: "I think all of the soldiers I saw were probably my students. I knew their groups and their respective generations. Most of them were not my students." Is that right?

utterances.speaker: EMIN KABASHI
utterances.text: Yes, that's right. This is what I said, and this is how it was.

utterances.speaker: MR. DJURDJIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Dr. Kabashi, do you know how many non-Albanian civilians were kidnapped and killed by the KLA throughout 1998 and 1999?

utterances.speaker: EMIN KABASHI
utterances.text: No, I don't know that. I don't have this kind of information.

utterances.speaker: MR. DJURDJIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Am I right to say you don't have any information indicating that the KLA were attacking policemen and members of Yugoslavia's army or killed them in 1998 and 1999?

utterances.speaker: EMIN KABASHI
utterances.text: No, I do have knowledge.

utterances.speaker: MR. DJURDJIC
utterances.text: Can you tell us anything about these attacks on the police and army, anything you know about that?

utterances.speaker: EMIN KABASHI
utterances.text: Police stations were targeted. During the fighting police and army were targeted, but I'm not able here to give you any exact figure as to how many Serb forces, members -- or KLA members were killed during these attacks.

utterances.speaker: MR. DJURDJIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Dr. Kabashi. I have no further questions.

utterances.speaker: MR. DJURDJIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, thank you. This concludes my cross-examination.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Djurdjic. Ms. D'Ascoli, is it practical to think that you would re-examine now or after the break? I leave the option depending on how long you think you will be.

utterances.speaker: MS. D'ASCOLI
utterances.text: Actually, I don't have questions in re-examination, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Well, that makes it very easy, Ms. D'Ascoli. Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Mr. Kabashi, you -- or Dr. Kabashi, you'll be pleased to know that that concludes the questions for you. The Chamber would like to thank you for your further attendance here in The Hague and for the assistance that you've been able to give. You are of course now free to return to your normal activities and the court officer will show you out after we rise for the break. Thank you indeed.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: We'll resume at 6.00.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: The next witness is Mr. Zyrapi, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Neuner. Can I mention for both counsel that we expect in respect of this witness to receive his statement and also his transcript of the proceedings in the Milutinovic trial, where he was extensively cross-examined, very extensively. The Chamber would suggest to counsel that they should keep in mind that his evidence and his cross-examination in that trial as well as his statement are in evidence and will be before the Chamber, so that we would suggest to counsel that it would be of very limited value to be simply going over again what matters are set out in the written material we will receive. There may be quite different matters that need to be examined in this case, but we strongly suggest that we would not be well served and we would really be wasting time simply to be going over matters that are clear from the written transcript. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Mr. Zyrapi.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Would you please read aloud the affirmation on the card that's shown to you now.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I solemnly declare that I will speak the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Thank you. Please sit down. Mr. Neuner has some questions for you. Yes, Mr. Neuner.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Good afternoon.

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: Good afternoon.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Your name is Bislim Zyrapi and you were born on the 9th of July, 1962 in Studencane, Suva Reka; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And in 2000 -- July 2006 you gave a statement to the OTP?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And before you came here today you had an opportunity to review that statement?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Five months later in November 2006 you testified over several days in the case against Milutinovic et al?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And before you came here today you reviewed your testimony, did you?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: So together, do the statement and the testimony truly and accurately reflect what you would say if you would testify today orally before this Court?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Your Honours, I would seek to tender the statement which has the 65 ter number 5239 into evidence.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: It will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: That will be P00427, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: I would also seek to tender the testimony, which has the 65 ter number 5201 and was given in the Milutinovic case, into evidence.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: It will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: That will be P00428, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: I will read out the summary of the witness testimony. The witness was a member of the Yugoslav Army and later of the Bosnian Army. In 1997 the KLA contacted him while he was in the Netherlands. He joined the KLA in March of 1998. Initially the witness worked in the military operations department of the General Staff of the KLA. From November 1998 until April 1999, the witness was Chief of Staff in the General Staff of the KLA. The witness testified about the KLA structure, including its operational zones and commanders. He trained soldiers and officers in the KLA. He described the movement of members of the General Staff into Kosovo from Albania and the planning of KLA military operations. The witness provided information about operations of the KLA in Kosovo. His evidence is relevant for paragraphs 25 to 32, 75(c), 78 until 101 of the indictment.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Witness, can you briefly describe the insignia worn by the KLA in 1998 and 1999.

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: Yes. The insignia worn by the KLA in 1998 and 1999 were two, actually, one worn on the sleeve and one on the cap. On the sleeve, the platform, the background was red; in the middle was the black eagle; and the inscription was "Kosovo Liberation Army" under the eagle and on top of the eagle, the initials UCK, the abbreviation. On the cap it was a round insignia, the background was red with a black eagle in the middle. Just beneath it was written "Kosovo Liberation Army" and on the top was the abbreviation UCK.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Could we have Exhibit P325 being shown to this witness, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: This is a photo-board which will come up in front of you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: If you could enlarge it to one screen, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And if you see, could you tell us which of the pictures depicts here the insignia of the KLA, if any?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: Picture number 10 depicts the insignia of the KLA.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Thank you. I would move on to the General Staff of the KLA.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Could we have Exhibit 600 -- sorry, 65 ter number 61507 on our screen.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And while that is happening, could I ask you: Where was the part of the General Staff of the KLA which stayed in Kosovo located from November 1998 onwards?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: From November 1998 until April 1999, while I was on that position, the staff was located in Divjak village, in the Berisha mountains.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Could we have the usher, please, handing out a marker for this witness.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: So that you please mark on that map, if it is visible, where Divjak is.

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Could you mark a 1 next to this.

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And was there a second location where the General Staff was?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: Part of the staff was located in Novoselle village.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And you marked a 2 next to this witness. Can you tell us from April 1999 onwards, where was the General Staff then located, please.

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: From April 1999 it was located in Devetak.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Could you mark a 3 next to the circle, please.

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Can you -- the 3 is legible now. Can you -- was there again a second location where the General Staff was?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: During this period there was a part of the staff, the political wing, which was located in Petrove village.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Which you have marked and circled with a 4 and you wrote a number 4 here on the map. Could you tell me between November 1998 and March/April 1999 where were you mostly located?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: From November 1998 until April 1999 I was mostly in Divjak village located.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Can I tender that map, Your Honours, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: It will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: That will be P00429, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: I want to talk about the next topic: Division of Kosovo in areas of responsibility of the Kosovo Liberation Army. You mentioned a couple of times operational zones of the KLA. Could you tell me hierarchically, were these operation zones below or above the General Staff of the KLA?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: The operational zones established in Kosova at the time were below, or under, the General Staff, hierarchically speaking.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: How many operational zones were there in Kosovo in 1999?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: At that time there was seven operational zones.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And would you be in a position to identify these seven operation zones on a map?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: The first zone was the Drenica Operational Zone --

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: I want to show you a map. I'm just asking whether you would be in a position to identify them if I show you a map?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: I will do my best to identify them on the map. The Drenica zone, which I don't see here --

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Sorry, the witness is confused because the old exhibit which was already tendered is still in front of him. Could it be removed from the screen.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: I want to -- I apologise. I want to show you another map and wanted to ask you simply whether you would be in a position to identify the zones there.

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: Yes, I would be able to do that.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Just -- this map was produced by the witness for Your Honours' information, and I'm talking about 65 ter number 2469. It was produced by the witness before he came to the Milutinovic testimony.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And, Witness, my first question is whether you recognise that map as the one which you have produced. It comes up in a second.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Could we enlarge it maybe a little bit. We just need the map itself. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Is that the map which you produced before you came to testify here in Milutinovic?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: If I could just walk you briefly here. Could you tell us what you have marked with Roman I, which zone is this?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: The zone marked with number I is the Drenica Operational Zone.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Roman II?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: Roman II, the Pashtrik Operational Zone; III, Dukagjini Operational Zone; IV, in the north, the Shala Operational Zone; V, the Llap Operational Zone; and VI Nerodime Operational Zone; and VII Karadak Operational Zone.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Could I seek to tender that document, Your Honours?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: It will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: That will be P00430, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: The next document is 2453. While it is coming up I can already introduce it.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: It is from the 23rd of June, 1998, Witness, and it says on the top of it: "Operational Zone Dukagjin." I wanted you to focus on the persons who are mentioned --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Mr. Djurdjic.

utterances.speaker: MR. DJURDJIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I believe we are experiencing some technical problems because I don't see the document in the Serbian language. I wanted to ask somebody to assist me with that because I would like to be able to see it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: The problem is to put a third document on the screen at the one time, it would be too small for anyone to see anything. The document is in e-court in Serbian, and it would be possible to bring it up onto your screen. We'll wait a moment while you get that organised.

utterances.speaker: MR. DJURDJIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, please proceed. My assistant will help me, and I will try to follow what I see on the screen.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Djurdjic.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: If we could focus for a moment on the persons which are mentioned under "proces-verbal," or minutes in English. We see the person Smajl is mentioned. Who is Smajl?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: Smajl was the alias of Ramush Haradinaj, commander of the Dukagjini Operational Zone.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And who is the second person, Mr. Maxhup?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: Maxhup was the pseudonym of Lahi Brahimaj, who was a former commander of the Dukagjini Operational Zone, but at the time he was member of the General Staff.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And then we see later that Agron is also mentioned among the persons being present. Who was Agron?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: Agroni or Agron is the pseudonym of Rexhep Selimi, the pseudonym he used at the time.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And in June 1998 at the meeting, in what capacity was he there?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: At the time Rexhep Selimi, a.k.a. Agron, was director of the operations of the general directorate of the KLA.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: It says in my translation "general directorate." Could you clarify what the level was?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: Head of the operational directorate of the General Staff of the KLA.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: If we go in English and Albanian to page 3 of these minutes, please, for a second. And I'm focusing here on the bold text, please, which is the seventh paragraph in English; and in the Albanian, the fourth paragraph.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Mr. Maxhup states here: "The formation of the Operational Staff of the Plain of Dukagjin was agreed and proclaimed unanimously." And then The Major adds -- makes a remark and it says in bold: "It was unanimously approved that the Staff should comprise: A commander, a deputy commander, an assistant for moral guidance and political affairs, a Chief of Staff, an assistant for logistics, for intelligence and counter-intelligence." Could you tell me, is that a normal formational structure for a KLA operational zone, all these positions?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: At this time the staff was being formed and within its structure the staff of the Dukagjini Operational Zone began to be established.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And is that structure with all the posts mentioned here typical for KLA operation zone structure?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: More or less, yes. As the zones developed further, they began to comprise more staff members.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Can we stay in Albanian on the same page but scroll down to the very bottom, and in English we would need to flip to the next page.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: I'm referring here to a remark of Mr. Agroni again.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And in English I believe it is the middle of the page. Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Mr. Agroni says: "Draw up a draft of what you think and the KLA General Staff will reply within two days." Do you remember at the time whether Agron mentioned anything about the formation of Dukagjin Operational Zone at the General Staff?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: Since at the time I was not near the staff. Later on I learned that the Dukagjin Operational Zone was formed.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: So indeed it was established?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: This is how the creation or the establishment of the Dukagjini Operational Zone began.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Can I seek to tender that document, Your Honours?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: It will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: That will be P00431, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: The next document is 2458, a document from the 8th of February, 1999, and we see here it has in the header the Pashtrik Operational Zone in its header.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: We see here that there on the left-hand side of the document numbers 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and so on, and I want you to focus on numbers 4 and 5.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: If we could scroll down a little bit, please, in English so that Your Honours can see that. Yes, thank you, and in B/C/S also.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: We see here the 124th and 125th brigade. Can you explain what are the information provided behind these brigades, what does that tell you?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: The brigades within the Pashtrik Operational Zone were starting with numbers 121 up to 126. The document defines the areas of responsibility of the brigades within the Pashtrik Operational Zones. It specifies the names of villages, locations, and elevations in this area or operations area of the Pashtrik Operational Zone.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: If you look for a moment at number 4, referring to the 124th Brigade, we see here in the third line that Krusha e Vogel railway station is mentioned. Can you explain why Krusha e Vogel railway station is mentioned?

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And while the witness is doing that, I would ask that the map 615.06 is put on the ELMO.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Could you explain what Krusha e Vogel railway station means here?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: The meaning of it is the border between the 124 Brigade and its neighbouring brigade, in this case the 125.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Could you mark on the map next to you where this railway station, Krusha e Vogel, is by encircling it.

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And mark a number 1 next to it, please.

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And then could you mark where Retimle is.

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And circle and mark a number 2 next to it.

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Could you tell me in that village which brigades were located there.

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: In Retimle village during the period November 1998/March 1999 was the command of the 124 and 125 Brigades.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Of which composition, of the Serb army or of the KLA?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: When we speak of these brigades, I'm referring to the KLA brigades, 124 and 125 Brigades.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: I want to tender Exhibit 2458 -- 65 ter number 2458, please, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: That's this map?

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: It's not the map. It's the document from which the witness was reading the railway station.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Yes, it will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: That will be P00432, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: The map will follow us up probably until tomorrow, Your Honours, and will be tendered probably tomorrow, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: I want to talk about appointment of brigade commanders in the KLA.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Could I have 65 ter number 2456 on our screen, please. The map can remain. We will need it a couple of times today and also the marker, please, could stay with the witness. No need to bring it every time again. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Yeah, Witness, if you look for a second at this document which is from the 7th of March, it says, if I read the first two lines, there is a suggestion made to appoint Mr. Selim Krasniqi to position of commander of the 125th Brigade. My question is: To whom is that proposal sent?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: The proposal has been made by the Pashtrik Operational Zone commander and was sent to the General Staff.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And how did the General Staff react to this proposal?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: After the proposal reached the staff, it was discussed and the proposal, at the time, was not adopted.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Were you involved in the discussions if at all?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: No. There were other members of the General Staff as well, General Staff of the KLA.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: But if you were also involved in discussions?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: Yes, I personally took part in the discussions.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: So after the General Staff rejected this proposal, was Selim Krasniqi appointed?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: No. The former -- the previous commander remained as commander of the zone.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Is it fair to say that against the will and decision of the General Staff, no KLA brigades could be appointed in 1999?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: I would seek to tender that document, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: That will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: That will be P00433, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: I'm moving on to the next topic of training, Exhibit -- sorry, 65 ter number 2467, please, on the screen.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: We see here a document from the 9th of February, 1999, an order, it says, from the Operational Zone Pashtrik. And the first line says: "Pursuant to the order of the General Staff of the UCK ..." and so on and so forth. Who in the General Staff of the KLA issued that order which is referred to here?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: The Chief of Staff has issued this order, meaning myself.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And then we see Mr. Rexha, the commander of Operational Zone Pashtrik, is here sending two men for training of battalion commanders. Could you tell me, how many battalion commanders were participating in the training activity?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: There were 30 battalion commanders who took part in that training.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Could you tell me from which operational zones of the KLA were these battalion commanders coming?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: They came from all the operational zones of the KLA.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And could you tell me, where did the training take place?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: The training took place in the village of Nishor.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Could you, if you find it, mark it and circle it on the map and mark a 3 next to it, please.

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: I don't get a picture here on the ELMO right now, Your Honours. There appears to be a technical problem. Yes, now it's coming. Could we maybe move the map a little bit because I can't see right now where the spot is which is marked by the witness. Yes, we see it is in the upper right-hand corner the witness has circled and marked a 3 next to the place where the training took place.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Could you tell me which type of training was provided on that occasion?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: At the time, the training of battalion commanders and other leaders consisted of training in the use of arms and weapons, tactical preparation in the use of their units.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And how long did the training last and did you yourself participate?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: Each group took part in a three-week training session, and I took part in the training as well.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Can I seek to tender 2467, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: It will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: That will be P00434, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Can I just ask, since we have the map in front of us, where was the headquarter of Operational Zone Pashtrik?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: The Pashtrik Operational Zone staff was in the same village. This village is made up of several groups of houses. The staff was located in the agricultural cooperative buildings.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: In Nishor?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: Yes, in Nishor.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Can I have the next document, 2459 displayed and we would need to have right away page 2, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Witness, you see here in front of you a document. Could you tell me who produced this document?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: I produced this document, and this document was used in the training of battalion commanders.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: In Nishor?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: Yes, in Nishor.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Could I seek to tender that document, Your Honours, 2459 is the 65 ter number .

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: It will be received.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: I'm told this is only one of a number of pages. Is it the whole document or merely this page?

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: I can ask the witness whether the entire batch related to training material.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Could you explain to Your Honours whether the entire batch was relating to training material?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: Yes, the whole batch of documents produced were used in the training of battalion commanders in Nishor.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: So, please, I would seek to tender the entire batch.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: The whole bundle will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Has P00435, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: I want to move on to orders now, 2449 is the 65 ter number of our next document.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And, Witness, you see already the first page here which is entitled: "Interim regulations of the organisation of internal affairs in the army," with the KLA insignia. Could you explain what these interim regulations are.

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: This document was issued in 1998 and it is a document that regulated the internal organisation of the KLA. We used the term "interim" here because there were changes that occurred as events developed.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: I have just one question relating to page 5 in Albanian and page 3, the last two paragraphs in English, and I'm referring here to the headline Roman II: Regulations on the giving and receiving of orders, because I want to talk about orders a little bit with you today. If you look at the second hyphen under number II or the second paragraph under number 2, it says --

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: I think in English it is the next page, Your Honours, we need to go to the next page, page number 4, please. Sorry, Albanian was fine. Yes. I think we are on the wrong -- one moment -- we need -- yeah, I think number II and then the second sentence there.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: "The soldier must report back to his superior officer as to the order carried out." Can you explain what that means in terms of KLA hierarchy and military theory?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: From what I can see here, the Albanian version is not on the same page as the English one.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: That's correct, but I believe you have this section number II in front of you, and it's being highlighted now. The sentence reads: "The soldier must report back to his superior officer as to the order carried out." Could you explain what that means in terms of military theory and the KLA structure?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: Yes. This regulates the military hierarchy from top down and bottom up. So the soldier, upon completion of the order, should or must report to his superior officer.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Can I seek to tender that document and the entire document relates to the internal rules of the KLA, Your Honours?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: The regulations will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: That will be under P00436, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And the next document is 2461.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And my first question when the document comes up is: Who signed the document?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: This document was signed by me.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Okay. We see here in number 1 that you order that regular daily combat reports have to be produced, and in number 2 you are saying that: " ... in exceptional situations involving movements or groupings by the enemy forces or surprise or sudden attacks, they should urgently inform the Chief of the KLA ..." Could you, first of all, tell me what enemy force have you envisaged here?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: Here I mean the Serb forces, military and police forces.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And who is the chief of the KLA who should be urgently informed -- sorry, chief of KLA General Staff it says in my translation.

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: At that time that person was me.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And who is -- where was the -- or who is the duty operations officer which should also be informed according to that document?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: The duty officers were from the operations directorate, and they worked together with me. All the duty officers worked in that directorate.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And where was that directorate located?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: The directorate was located in the same building that the staff was, which is the building in Divjak.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And who is the deputy commander of the KLA General Staff who should also be informed, according to that document?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: At the time deputy commander of the General Staff who was at the time located in the same village as I was, this person was Jakup Krasniqi.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Could I seek to tender 2461 into evidence, Your Honours?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: It will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: That will be P00437, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Moving on to types of orders, the next document has the number 251.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: There is maybe a problem with the number. I'm trying to fix it. 2451 is needed. Yeah.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: First of all, I would be interested, if you can tell us, Who signed this document, which is from 2nd of July, 1998.

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: This document bears the signature of the commander of Operational Zone of Dukagjin, Ramush Haradinaj.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And we see here that six men are dispatched as reinforcement. In military terms what does "reinforcement" mean?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: "Reinforcement" in the military sense means that the village in question asked for assistance and the next military unit sent a group of soldiers to assist that unit. That's called "reinforcement."

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Is this a superior unit which is sending reinforcements?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: The zone command sent the reinforcement to the area which was under their responsibility.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Could I seek to tender that document, 2451, into evidence.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: It will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: That will be P00438, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: The next document is 2452 from the same day, 2nd of July, 1998.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: And I would again, if it comes up in a second, ask you to tell us whose signature we can see, whether you know that signature?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Mr. Djurdjic.

utterances.speaker: MR. DJURDJIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, I wanted to intervene a minute ago, but I gave it some time. This is the second document of the same sort, and they have nothing to do with the witness. One operational zone in the previous document shows that Ramush Haradinaj sent reinforcements to his unit or village, but there was no reference to the KLA staff or this witness here. As far as I can tell, it seems to me that this is the same type of document and -- that probably originated from the Dukadjini Operational Zone, and I don't know what that has to do with the witness. I don't even know if the witness was at the time -- oh, I can see that he indeed was a member of the Main Staff.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: This witness is coming to prove the hierarchy within the KLA and explain us military documents which were issued in or on the levels of the hierarchy of the KLA. And I'm always asking this witness whether he's recognising the signature and can tell us who that person is. He has identified Mr. Haradinaj earlier in a document which I've shown from this zone. We have understood that the operational zones are directly below the General Staff of the KLA to which the witness belonged to. So he's talking here about documents signed by subordinates of him. I believe that gives a foundation for me to ask questions.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Mr. Djurdjic.

utterances.speaker: MR. DJURDJIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I believe that Mr. Neuner has reached a problematic situation. The witness showed him and drew him a picture of operational zones at the moment when he became the chief of the general -- of the Main Staff of the KLA. And these documents talk about the operational zones as they were before 1998, before he arrived, and the witness himself said it that the period in question differed from the period -- from the subsequent periods, i.e., when he became the chief of the Main Staff.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Mr. Neuner.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: It is in the witness's testimony which I have tendered, I think, as the second document today that the witness has arrived in Kosovo in March 1998 and was also working in the General Staff throughout the summer 1998. It's also in the witness's testimony that he has worked in the operations department. This is an order here relating to moving of staff, probably relating to certain operations, and I believe I have a good-faith basis to ask questions upon it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Mr. Neuner, can you assist me by telling me what is the relevance of this order and document to our case?

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: First of all, I'm almost identically tendering the same documents which were tendered in the MOS case and this is the --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: In the what case?

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: In the Milutinovic et al case, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: And how does that help us?

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: This does not help necessarily. I was trying to make another point. I just wanted to say that this is relating here to the internal organisation of the KLA and shows the power of zone commanders. If Your Honours are not agreeing that this is relevant, I'm prepared to move on, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Well, it does arise as a question in my mind, at least, to what extent the internal organisation of the KLA is going to be relevant to the issues in this case.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Our position would be, Your Honours, that as part of an armed conflict there must be two -- at least two forces which have an internal structure --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: So you're seeking to prove that this was an organised military structure?

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Correct, Your Honours, and this is just one little piece in this chain which we are trying to establish, inter alia, through this witness, showing and demonstrating the internal organisation of that adversary unit.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Very well. The relevance indicated by Mr. Neuner is valid, that is, to show that there was, in truth, a structured military force in opposition to the Serbian forces which is relevant to jurisdiction and offences. The purpose of the document as advanced by the Prosecution is to demonstrate the working procedures of the KLA, and that, as a general background, is a relevant evidentiary area. For those reasons, Mr. Djurdjic, these questions are admissible and the evidence of this witness has been sufficiently established to indicate that he can speak about documents of this type. All of that having happened, we've run out of time, Mr. Neuner.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: May I be allowed to just ask one question relating to re-assignment and then seek to tender that document so that I don't have to touch upon it tomorrow morning or afternoon?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Yes, you may.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Could you explain to Your Honours what a re-assignment order is, please, in military terms?

utterances.speaker: BISLIM ZYRAPI
utterances.text: Yes. Re-assignment is what an -- a superior officer does. He used to be part of the staff, and he has been appointed to another unit. He was appointed from one unit to another.

utterances.speaker: MR. NEUNER
utterances.text: Could I seek to tender this document with this explanation --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: It will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: That will be P00439, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: We must now adjourn for the day. We resume tomorrow I believe in the morning, at 9.00. Mr. Zyrapi, we have now to adjourn for the night. We continue at 9.00 tomorrow morning. The court staff will discuss with you during the break the arrangements for you to be here in the morning. Thank you very much. We now adjourn.
